title: DREADHOLLOW MANOR
description: A haunted-house game for the Game Boy Color. You are an explorer trapped in Dreadhollow Manor: each night, three relics - a chalice, a skull, and an amulet - are hidden somewhere in its six rooms. Find all three to survive to the next, darker night, while a growing pack of wraiths (one more every night, up to five) fades in and hunts you. Banish them with your lantern bolt, weave through the furniture, and do not let a fully-formed wraith touch you. A from-scratch Game Boy Color rebuild of the Atari 2600 original, written in C with GBDK-2020.
